Full log with orientation record, entity record, looks register, and leads is saved at `work/exploration-log.md`. Here's the profile.

## Northgate Clinic — account profile (Jan–Jun 2026)

**Identity note first, because it affects everything else:** the data has no single account ID for "Northgate Clinic" across the full window. `accounts.csv` shows `ACC-1042` ("Northgate Clinic," valid through 2026-03-31) and `ACC-1077` ("Northgate Health Partners (formerly Northgate Clinic)," valid from 2026-04-01). The adjacent dates and the parenthetical name strongly suggest the same account continued under a new ID/name — but no source states this linkage explicitly, so I'm treating it as a well-supported inference, not a fact the records settle on their own. Everything below stitches the two IDs together on that basis.

**Month by month:**

| Month | Contract status | Plan | Billed volume | Amount | Tickets |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Jan | active (1042) | standard | 1,840 | $772.80 | 1 (feature-request) |
| Feb | **paused** (1042) | — | *no billing row* | — | none |
| Mar | active (1042) | enterprise-annual (changed 3/1) | 1,910 | $592.10 | 2 (feature-request, integration) |
| Apr | active (**1077**) | enterprise-annual | 1,120 | $347.20 | 2 (both billing-question) |
| May | active (1077) | enterprise-annual | 1,085 | $336.35 | 1 (outage-report) |
| Jun | *no record* | — | *no billing row* | — | none |

**What the records settle:**
- The account paused in February and resumed in March.
- It moved from the "standard" plan to "enterprise-annual" effective March 1 — matching the plan_changes.csv entry and the Jan→Mar billing values.
- The account ID/name changed from ACC-1042/"Northgate Clinic" to ACC-1077/"Northgate Health Partners" at the March/April boundary.
- Billed volume dropped ~41% from March ($592.10) to April ($347.20) on the same plan tier, coinciding with that ID change — stated as a sequence, not a cause.
- Ticket topics shifted: feature/integration requests in Jan–Mar, two billing-question tickets right after the ID change in April, one outage report in May.

**Data-quality flags (not chased further, per profile scope):**
- **No June data at all** for this account — no billing row, no contract-status row, no tickets. Contract_status.csv has no June row for *any* account, so that part is an export-wide gap. But billing.csv *does* have June rows for the three other accounts — Northgate/ACC-1077 is the only one missing a June bill, which looks specific to this account rather than a general export issue.
- The ACC-1042 → ACC-1077 identity link is inferred, not asserted anywhere in the source data.

If you want either of these settled (was June really unbilled, and is the ID change really the same account), that's confirmation work for a follow-up investigation — I can hand off the specific leads (recorded as D1–D4 in the log) if useful.
